```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(jsonlite)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})
opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)

# ---- read meta (from anagine report.js) ----
meta <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(params$meta_json, flatten = TRUE), error = function(e) list())
requested_by <- if (!is.null(meta$requested_by)) as.character(meta$requested_by)[1] else ""
if (length(requested_by) == 0 || is.na(requested_by) || requested_by == "") requested_by <- ""

escape_latex_text <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || x == "") return("")
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
  x <- gsub("([#$%&_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}

# prefer meta$generated_at (so cover date is tied to this report call)
generated_at <- if (!is.null(meta$generated_at)) as.character(meta$generated_at) else ""
if (length(generated_at) == 0 || is.na(generated_at[1]) || generated_at[1] == "") {
  gt <- Sys.time()
} else {
  # Robust ISO8601 parse: support trailing Z and offset like +00:00.
  ga <- generated_at[1]
  ga <- sub("Z$", "+0000", ga)
  ga <- sub("([+-][0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2})$", "\\1\\2", ga)
  gt <- as.POSIXct(ga, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS%z", tz = "UTC")
  if (is.na(gt)) gt <- Sys.time()
}

report_month <- format(gt, "%B, %Y")
report_date  <- format(gt, "%B %d, %Y")
gt_et <- as.POSIXct(format(gt, tz = "America/New_York", usetz = TRUE), tz = "America/New_York")
report_time  <- format(gt_et, "%I:%M %p %Z")

# fetchedData -> data.frame
df <- meta$fetchedData
if (is.null(df)) df <- data.frame()
if (is.list(df) && !is.data.frame(df)) df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df)

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  nm <- names(df)
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% nm]
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
}

# adjust these candidates if your guppy fields use different names
yob_col  <- pick_col(df, c("year_of_birth","YearOfBirth","yob"))
meld_col <- pick_col(df, c("meld","MELD","meld_score","meld_total"))
cohort_col <- pick_col(df, c("cohort","Cohort","case_group"))

# derive age (approx) from year_of_birth + report year
if (!is.na(yob_col)) {
  df$year_of_birth_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[yob_col]]))
  df$age <- as.integer(format(gt, "%Y")) - df$year_of_birth_num
  df$age <- ifelse(is.finite(df$age) & df$age >= 0 & df$age <= 120, df$age, NA_integer_)
}

# meld
if (!is.na(meld_col)) {
  meld_raw <- df[[meld_col]]
  df$meld <- vapply(meld_raw, function(v) {
    if (is.null(v)) return(NA_real_)
    if (is.list(v) || is.vector(v)) {
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(v)))
      vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
      if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      return(max(vals))
    }
    n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    if (is.finite(n)) return(n)
    return(NA_real_)
  }, numeric(1))
  df$meld <- ifelse(is.finite(df$meld), df$meld, NA_real_)
}

# Groups from cohort + study type prefix (obs/clinical/unknown).
if (!is.na(cohort_col)) {
  df$cohort_value <- as.character(df[[cohort_col]])
} else {
  df$cohort_value <- NA_character_
}
df$cohort_value[is.na(df$cohort_value) | trimws(df$cohort_value) == ""] <- "Unknown"

# Prefer studies.submitter_id, then submitter_id, then pat_id, then _case_id.
study_submitter_col <- pick_col(df, c("studies.submitter_id","studies.submitter_id.1"))
id_col <- pick_col(df, c("submitter_id","SubmitterID","pat_id","_case_id"))
raw_id <- if (!is.na(study_submitter_col)) as.character(df[[study_submitter_col]]) else if (!is.na(id_col)) as.character(df[[id_col]]) else rep("", nrow(df))
raw_id[is.na(raw_id)] <- ""

df$study_prefix <- ifelse(
  grepl("_obs(_|$)", raw_id, ignore.case = TRUE), "obs",
  ifelse(grepl("_clinical(_|$)", raw_id, ignore.case = TRUE), "clinical", "unknown")
)
df$group_label <- paste0(df$study_prefix, "-", df$cohort_value)
```

```{r cover_pdf, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  cat("\\centering\n")
  if (file.exists("AlcHepNet_logo.jpg")) {
    cat("\\includegraphics[width=0.62\\textwidth]{AlcHepNet_logo.jpg}\n\n")
  }
  cat("\\begin{LARGE}\n")
  cat("Age and MELD stats report\n")
  cat("\\end{LARGE}\n\n")
  if (nzchar(requested_by)) {
    cat("\\vspace{6pt}\n")
    cat(sprintf("Report generated for %s\n\n", escape_latex_text(requested_by)))
  }
  cat("\\vspace{12pt}\n\\vspace{12pt}\n")
  cat("\\begin{LARGE}\n")
  cat(report_month)
  cat("\n\\end{LARGE}\n\n")
  cat("\\vspace{12pt}\n")
  cat("\\begin{center}\n")
  cat(sprintf("Data extracted %s at %s\n", report_date, report_time))
  cat("\\end{center}\n")
  cat("\\raggedright\n")
  cat("\\clearpage\n\n")

  # Page 2: Contents first, then Tables/Figures.
  cat("\\begingroup\n")
  cat("\\renewcommand{\\contentsname}{Contents}\n")
  cat("\\tableofcontents\n")
  cat("\\vspace{18pt}\n")
  cat("\\renewcommand{\\listtablename}{Tables}\n")
  cat("\\listoftables\n")
  cat("\\vspace{18pt}\n")
  cat("\\renewcommand{\\listfigurename}{Figures}\n")
  cat("\\listoffigures\n")
  cat("\\endgroup\n")
  cat("\\clearpage\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (!("age" %in% names(df)) || all(is.na(df$age))) {
  cat("No age information available. Please include year_of_birth in fetch fields.\n")
} else {
  age_vec <- df$age[!is.na(df$age)]
  age_tbl <- data.frame(
    `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", round(mean(age_vec)), round(sd(age_vec))),
    Median      = round(median(age_vec)),
    Minimum     = min(age_vec),
    Maximum     = max(age_vec),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  age_kable <- kable(
    age_tbl,
    if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
    caption = "Age breakdown",
    align = "c",
    booktabs = FALSE,
    position = "H"
  )
  age_kable
}
```

```{r meld_hist, fig.cap="MELD histogram with binsize = 5", fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
if (!("meld" %in% names(df)) || all(is.na(df$meld))) {
  cat("No MELD information available. Please include meld field in fetch fields.\n")
} else {
  dd <- df %>% filter(!is.na(meld))
  N <- nrow(dd)

  bin_w <- 5
  breaks <- seq(
    floor(min(dd$meld)/bin_w)*bin_w,
    ceiling(max(dd$meld)/bin_w)*bin_w + bin_w,
    by = bin_w
  )

  dd <- dd %>%
    mutate(meld_bin = cut(meld, breaks = breaks, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE))

  bin_counts <- dd %>%
    count(meld_bin, group_label, name="n") %>%
    group_by(meld_bin) %>%
    mutate(ypos = cumsum(n) - n/2) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(bin_counts, aes(x = meld_bin, y = n, fill = group_label)) +
    geom_col(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(y = ypos, label = ifelse(n>0, n, "")), size = 4) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("MELD Histogram with binsize = %d (N=%d)", bin_w, N),
      x = "MELD", y = "Frequency", fill = "Groups"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```
